children: VanEck Merk Gold ETF reported results for the third quarter ended July 31, 2026, registering a net loss of $(352.4M) versus a $(4.8M) loss in the year-ago quarter; EPS metrics were not reported as the trust’s activity is limited to holding gold and performance is driven by changes in the value of its bullion holdings.
Net income: $(352.4M) for Q3 2026, compared with $(4.8M) in Q3 2025.
Diluted EPS: Not reported for the period; EPS metrics are not provided in Part I Item 1/2.

Revenue: Not applicable — the trust’s sole activity is holding gold; the report shows a net investment loss of $(1.68M) for Q3 2026 and realized/unrealized gains (losses) on gold rather than operating revenue.
NAV and gold price impact: Net asset value fell about 10.18% during the quarter and about 12.59% year-to-date, driven by declines in the market value of gold bullion held by the trust.
Shares and creations: Outstanding shares increased from 63.6M to 65.2M during the quarter through creations by Authorized Participants; the sponsor fee is paid in shares.
Index and pricing: The trust uses the Solactive Gold Spot Index (adopted Aug. 7, 2023) with NYSE close pricing based on a TWAP methodology.
Fees and expenses: The sponsor assumes most expenses; the sponsor fee is set at 0.25% annually, accrued daily and paid monthly in shares.
Settlement and AP agreements: Creation/redemption settlement moved to T+1 effective May 28, 2024, and Authorized Participant Agreements were amended to reflect that change.
